recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current source already implements the final Jira disposition, so further edits would be redundant and could risk disturbing later unrelated Device.additive refinements.
issue_request: FHIR-50160 was an Applied FHIR-core Device issue from OO, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R6, asking to remove Device.additive.performer and Device.additive.performed because dynamic procedure-focused additive details do not belong on Device. It also requested Procedure boundary text and a Device.additive comment directing implementers to Procedure for details of adding a substance.
initial_application: FHIR-49741 initially added Device.additive with type, quantity, performer, and performed. FHIR-50160 was then applied by commit 7983eb8596914813665b09a62a3181c4ec20bc1d, merged via PR #3703 as db5be60e5bf532d907180a0d1607ec7473d248e2, which removed the two subelements and added the requested guidance.
additional_context: The 2025-09-29 OO Specimen minutes record the rationale that performer and timing details should be represented with Procedure on the referenced device, and the HCP minutes record agreement with the proposed disposition and the 7-0-1 Persuasive with Modification vote. source/fhir.ini lists device=Device in the active resources list, confirming the checked Device source is in build scope.
reconciliation: No source changes were made. Current source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml defines Device.additive with the requested Procedure comment and only type and quantity children, source/device/device-introduction.xml contains the requested Procedure boundary sentence, and a source search found no remaining Device.additive.performer or Device.additive.performed definitions.
